headline: Giving Up High Salary in Silicon Valley to Return Home, 69-Year-Old Works for 32 Years to Build a 210 Billion Yuan Chip King
summary: A 69-year-old executive gave up a Silicon Valley career to return to China and spent 32 years building a chip company valued at 210 billion yuan. The company is Montage Technology.
why: Montage Technology is a Chinese chip designer focused on memory interface and data-center semiconductors, a sector central to China's chip supply push.
